mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT stock_code FROM domestic_base_price ORDER BY stock_code

SELECT p.stock_code AS ticker, p.close_price AS price_krw, (SELECT q.close_price FROM domestic_base_price q WHERE q.stock_code = p.stock_code AND q.base_date = (SELECT MAX(r.base_date) FROM domestic_base_price r WHERE r.stock_code = p.stock_code AND r.base_date < p.base_date) ) AS previous_close_krw, p.base_date, p.fetched_at AS price_at, p.source FROM domestic_base_price p JOIN ( SELECT stock_code, MAX(base_date) AS base_date FROM domestic_base_price WHERE base_date <= #{asOf} AND stock_code IN
#{ticker}
GROUP BY stock_code ) latest ON latest.stock_code = p.stock_code AND latest.base_date = p.base_date
WHERE p.close_price IS NOT NULL AND p.close_price > 0 ORDER BY p.stock_code
